purpose: pre-official-score in-corpus adult-prose clean-prior and rate-account commitment

prediction_commitment.primary_commitment: conditional_rate_commitment: official in-corpus broad late gain should be small/repeat-like if the same-script in-corpus admitted-block loss reduction from 60M to 100M is at or below the repeat-distinct midpoint; it should approach the view/breadth late-retention regime only if that 60M->100M reduction remains distinct-like. The current clean-prior level is recorded now and must not be used alone as the mechanism.

rate_to_downstream_descriptive_fit.warning: three-arm descriptive calibration only; use as a frozen quantitative lens, not as proof of causality

interpretation_rule.static_profile_proximity: adult-prose official scores high even if in-corpus admitted-block loss collapsed early; this would identify distribution target proximity more than active late error
interpretation_rule.out_of_corpus_novelty: in-corpus scores flat while FineWeb view/breadth stay positive; this would favor novelty/out-of-corpus content not official adult prose alone
interpretation_rule.rate_account: official late movement tracks in-corpus 60M->100M admitted-block loss reduction; rows that stay active late support transfer, rows exhausted early do not
